title: United Kingdom: products must be safe
summary: A producer may only place a consumer product on the GB market if it is safe in normal or reasonably foreseeable use. Where a producer knows a product poses a risk incompatible with that requirement, they must notify an enforcement authority in writing.

required_evidence.label: Documented assessment that the product is safe in foreseeable use

sources.title: The General Product Safety Regulations 2005
sources.note: Regulation number not yet confirmed against the instrument; GOV.UK guidance describes the general safety requirement but the reg. number here is unverified.
